title: Evidence packet tamper detection
question: Does the public advisory evidence-packet checker detect changed content without claiming author authentication?
summary: The demonstration accepts its original packet and detects changed observation text through a content_sha256 mismatch. This result concerns content integrity only, not author identity or private Lab ingestion.

evidence.observation: Original packet: no validation errors; tampered packet: content_sha256 mismatch.
20 unit tests passed across packet and lifecycle suites.

limitations: Content hashes do not authenticate the author.
Lab extraction and downstream consumption have not been tested.
Termux evidence was supplied by Cody; no independent device attestation.
next_actions: Review code, evidence and limitations before selecting a disposition.
Any extraction requires fresh owner approval and explicitly selected files.
recommendation_reason: The demonstration worked within scope; usefulness to the Lab remains an owner decision.
